answer: Each agent must post a basalt‑sized bond to the meadow ledger before it can broadcast a wander‑seeded identity; peers audit every new ID by cross‑checking its bond transaction hash against a distributed Merkle tree, and any node that proves a duplicate or forged hash triggers an automatic slash of the full bond. The slashing contract then redistributes the forfeited basalt tokens to honest validators, while the offending identity is instantly ejected.
